name: Aconitum
source:
In autumn, on the first day of transferring schools, he saw a video recording of a school band. He was completely overwhelmed by the amazing sound, and thought: "I want to meet those guys." With hope in his heart, he starts his life at school, but...

[Roughly translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190212182110/http://aconitum.webcrow.jp/]official site[/url]]
translation:
秋天，转学的第一天，他看到了学校乐队的录像。他完全被这令人惊叹的声音所震撼，心想：“我想见见那些家伙。”满怀希望的他开始了学校生活，但是……

[大致翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190212182110/http://aconitum.webcrow.jp/]官方网站[/url]]
